# Assist

> Assist is a native Mac app for voice-powered screen annotation, full-screen screenshots, and clipboard history from the notch. Local-first: screenshots, transcripts, and history stay on your Mac.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS 14 (Sonoma) or later
- Main features: voice-powered annotation, full-screen screenshots, and clipboard history
- Price: $20 one-time purchase, no subscription
- License: one device per license, lifetime access with 1.x updates included
- Clipboard: keeps copied text in local history alongside screenshots for copying, dragging, and reuse
- Voice: optional local Whisper transcription on Apple silicon; raw audio is never persisted
- Storage: local-first; screenshots, copied text, and transcripts stay on your Mac
- Capture: Control + Option for a full-screen screenshot with a quick crop, blur, and framing editor; hold Option to draw and optionally dictate before capture
- Reuse: drag recent screenshots, annotations, and copied text from the notch shelf into documents, chats, and design tools
